items.exampleEn: Cook the vegetables in a little oil.
Would you like red wine or white wine?
Put the cake on a plate.
There is too much salt in this soup.
My dad drinks a beer after work on Fridays.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸星期五下班後會喝一瓶啤酒。

items.exampleEn: Rice is a big part of our diet.
items.exampleZh: 米飯是我們飲食中很重要的一部分。

items.exampleEn: This chicken comes with a sweet sauce.
items.exampleZh: 這道雞肉附一種甜甜的醬汁。

items.sentenceEn: Could you pass me the salt, please?
items.sentenceZh: 可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？

items.audioEn: I'm not drinking beer tonight because I'm driving.
items.audioZh: 我今晚不喝啤酒，因為我要開車。
items.questionZh: 說話的人今晚為什麼不喝啤酒？

items.sentenceEn: After the long walk, we were very thirsty.
items.sentenceZh: 走了很久之後，我們都非常口渴。

items.sentenceEn: Please wash the plates after dinner.
items.sentenceZh: 晚餐後請把盤子洗乾淨。

items.stemEn: I'm so ____. Can I have a glass of water?
items.stemZh: 我好渴，可以給我一杯水嗎？

items.stemEn: Do you want some tomato ____ on your pasta?
items.stemZh: 你的義大利麵要不要加一點番茄醬汁？

items.passageEn: Sara's family is trying a new diet this month. They eat more fish and vegetables, and they use less oil and salt. Sara's father stopped drinking beer, and her mother only has a little wine on Saturdays. They also make their own sauces without sugar. "At first, I missed fried chicken," Sara says, "but now I feel great."
items.passageZh: Sara 家這個月在嘗試新的飲食方式。他們多吃魚和蔬菜，少用油和鹽。Sara 的爸爸不再喝啤酒，媽媽只在星期六喝一點葡萄酒。他們也自己做不加糖的醬汁。Sara 說：「一開始我很想念炸雞，但現在我覺得身體很好。」

questions.questionZh: Sara 家這個月在飲食上做了什麼改變？
options: 多吃魚和蔬菜、少用油和鹽

questions.questionZh: Sara 的媽媽什麼時候喝一點葡萄酒？

rubricZh: 「太小」可寫例如 too small、isn't big enough

items.instructionZh: 用 diet 造一個句子，說說你平常的飲食習慣。
referenceEn: My diet has a lot of fruit and vegetables.
I don't eat much meat in my diet.
rubricZh: diet 指「日常飲食」（例如 my diet、a healthy diet）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My diet has）
